title: Arkret KeyViewProof
description: Inclusion proof for one KeyView record against a Seal's data_view_root (authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md sections 6.4 and 10). data_view_root is the RFC 6962 Merkle root over canonical KeyView leaves sorted by cell_id; this proof lets a light client verify 'this Seal observed and committed this local join result for this cell' without global state. The proof is observational: absence of a KeyView never invalidates a DataEvent, and verifiers MUST NOT treat it as finality.

data_view_root.description: MUST equal the data_view_root field of the referenced Seal; the verifier checks the Seal signature separately.

audit_path.description: RFC 6962 Merkle audit path from the canonical KeyView leaf to data_view_root. Leaf input is H(0x00 || canonical_json(key_view)); interior nodes are H(0x01 || left || right).

heads.description: Exposed head digests for multi-value cells. Mutually exclusive with value_digest.

value_digest.description: Digest of the canonical single join value. Mutually exclusive with heads.

last_covered_event.description: event_digest of the latest DataEvent the notary observed for this cell within the Seal window.
